hero.headline: The Spanish expertise your product needs.
hero.subheadline: Xpandia helps teams validate, improve, and culturally adapt high-impact Spanish experiences across AI outputs, product flows, support content, marketing, and customer journeys.
hero.supportingLine: Built for AI, SaaS, EdTech, Product, Localization, CX, and Marketing teams serving English and Spanish-speaking audiences.

decision.headline: What does your team need to solve?
decision.intro: Start with the outcome your team needs. Xpandia structures each engagement around a clear business question: is your Spanish ready, does it need to be repaired or adapted, or does your team need deeper cultural insight?

cards.title: Need to know if your Spanish is ready?
cards.body: For teams that already have Spanish AI outputs, product flows, support content, or localized experiences and need expert validation before launch, scale, or release.
bestWhen: Audit a product or customer journey in Spanish.
Prioritize fixes by severity and business impact.
Create standards for ongoing Spanish quality.

cards.title: Need to repair or improve Spanish content?
cards.body: For teams with Spanish content, product copy, support content, marketing, documentation, or customer-facing experiences that need to feel clearer, more natural, more consistent, and more audience-ready.
bestWhen: Improve existing Spanish and English content.
Repair translated, inconsistent, or underperforming language.
Adapt product, support, or marketing copy for real users.
Align terminology, tone, and regional Spanish.
Prepare Spanish assets for QA, launch, or publication.

cards.title: Need to understand your audience beyond language?
cards.body: For teams that need cultural insight, messaging guidance, market readiness, training, and strategic direction to connect with English and Spanish-speaking audiences.
bestWhen: Understand cultural expectations and trust signals.
Identify cultural friction before it affects adoption or conversion.
Make better product, content, CX, and go-to-market decisions.

comparison.headline: The difference is simple: validate, repair, or understand.
comparison.intro: Many teams start with an audit, then move into repair, retesting, sign-off, cultural insight, or ongoing advisory. Xpandia can support a focused need or help build a broader Spanish quality roadmap.

rows.need: Know whether Spanish outputs, product flows, or support content are ready to ship
Improve Spanish content that exists but does not feel natural, clear, or audience-ready
rows.outcome: Spanish content built for real users

rows.need: Understand Hispanic/LatAm audiences, cultural expectations, trust, and market fit
Build repeatable standards and ongoing quality support

coreSolutions.headline: Focused engagements designed to create momentum.
coreSolutions.intro: Start with a clear scope, expert human review, practical deliverables, and recommendations your team can act on quickly.

cards.name: AI Quality Audit Sprint
cards.bestFor: Teams with AI outputs, chatbot responses, tutors, copilots, agents, or automated support flows operating in Spanish and English.
cards.outcome: Understand quality risks, scoring, issue patterns, and readiness before users rely on the experience.

cards.name: Spanish Launch Readiness Audit
cards.bestFor: Teams launching or preparing a Spanish or English website, app, onboarding flow, support journey, AI experience, or customer-facing product surface.
cards.outcome: Identify what affects clarity, trust, UX, cultural fit, conversion, and readiness before launch or relaunch.

cards.name: Language Experience Repair
cards.bestFor: Teams with existing Spanish or English content that sounds translated, inconsistent, unclear, generic, too literal, or not ready for real users.
cards.outcome: Turn underperforming language into content that feels clear, natural, trustworthy, and aligned with your product, audience, and business goal.

cards.name: ACI Talk / Executive Briefing
cards.bestFor: Leadership, Product, Marketing, CX, Localization, People, and Global Operations teams working across cultures, markets, languages, or international teams.
cards.outcome: Help your team understand how the Cultural Intelligence (CQ) engine helps build more productive teams that drive trust, positive feedback, market readiness, audience expectations, and increased ROI.
deliverables: 45–60 minute live talk or executive briefing

cards.name: Hispanic Audience & Messaging Review
cards.bestFor: Marketing, Growth, Product Marketing, CX, Localization, and leadership teams adapting messages for Hispanic, LatAm, US Hispanic, or Spanish-speaking audiences.
cards.outcome: Identify whether your message is clear, credible, culturally aligned, persuasive, and built around the trust signals your audience needs.

cards.name: Language Quality Advisory
cards.bestFor: Teams that need ongoing senior Spanish/English quality judgment, review workflows, QA standards, vendor/reviewer alignment, terminology guidance, or recurring quality decisions.
cards.outcome: Build a practical Spanish/English quality system your team can use to make better decisions, reduce review friction, and scale quality with confidence.

engagementModel.headline: Clear scope. Expert review. Actionable output.

steps.title: Scope the need
steps.body: We define your audience, Spanish variant, product surface, content type, business objective, timeline, and expected outcome.

steps.title: Review the experience
steps.body: We evaluate or adapt the selected material using expert human judgment and the right mix of linguistic, cultural, UX, and product quality signals.

steps.title: Deliver the evidence
steps.body: You receive decision-ready findings your team can use immediately: scorecards, annotated examples, issue logs, severity ratings, prioritized recommendations, rewrites, standards, or training materials.

steps.title: Decide the next move
steps.body: We recommend the right next step: ship, fix, retest, localize, adapt, train, govern, or scale.

pricing.headline: Simple starting points for focused work.
pricing.body: Pricing depends on scope, volume, content type, product complexity, and timeline. Most teams begin with a focused audit, sprint, workshop, or localization review.

cards.name: Diagnostics
cards.desc: Get a fast expert read before Spanish issues turn into user friction, launch delays, or avoidable rework. Best when your team needs to understand what is happening, what matters most, and which engagement will create the fastest path forward.

cards.name: Launch Readiness Audits
cards.desc: Find the issues affecting clarity, trust, UX, conversion, or customer confidence in your Spanish experience. Designed for product, AI, localization, support, CX, and marketing teams that need structured findings, severity ratings, and prioritized recommendations they can act on now.

cards.name: AI QA Sprints
cards.desc: Validate AI-generated Spanish before users rely on or complain about it. For teams evaluating chatbot responses, copilots, tutors, agents, support flows, or other AI outputs that need to be accurate, natural, safe, consistent, and ready for real Spanish-speaking users.

cards.name: Localization & Adaptation
cards.desc: Turn English-first or underperforming Spanish content into experiences that feel clear, natural, and built for your audience. For websites, product copy, help content, campaigns, learning materials, and Spanish content that needs to support trust, conversion, comprehension, and action.

cards.name: Cultural Intelligence Talks & Workshops
cards.price: Talks from $1,500 · Briefings from $2,500 · Workshops from $4,500
cards.desc: Help global teams read the invisible rules behind trust, communication, decision-making, and market readiness. For leaders and teams that need Cultural Intelligence talks, executive briefings, or custom workshops on cross-cultural communication, culturalization, Spanish-speaking audiences, and global business growth.

cards.name: Fractional Advisory
cards.desc: Bring senior Spanish Localization QA leadership into your team without a full-time hire. For companies that need ongoing governance, vendor ops oversight, QA frameworks, review workflows, terminology standards, quality dashboards, or strategic guidance to scale Spanish quality with confidence.

pricing.noteTitle: Final pricing is confirmed after a short diagnostic call and scope review.
pricing.noteBody: We will help you identify the fastest, most practical path to improve Spanish quality, reduce risk, and move your product, content, or team forward.

finalCta.headline: Let's identify the right Spanish quality path for your team.
finalCta.body: Tell us what your team is building, launching, localizing, validating, or improving. We'll recommend the right engagement based on your product, audience, timeline, and business goal.
